spans.s: + योनि शैल-सुता-चरण-राग- + योनि, adj. produced by the colour of the feet of Pārvatī, Vikr. d. 128.
+ राज शैल- + राज, m. the king of the mountains, epithet of the Himālaya,
Megh. 51

शैल, i. e. शिला + अ,
 I. adj.
 1. Stony,

; rocky.
 2. Mountainous, mountaineer.
 II. m.
 1. A mountain,

. A dike, Pañc. i. d. 115.
 III. n.
 1.

Bitumen.
 2

. Storax.
 --Comp.

शैल-ज, adj. Produced in or on mountains.
 --Comp.
शैल + मय, adj., f. यी, Rocky, consisting of stones,
Rājat. 5, 103

शैलाट, i. e. शैल-अट् + अ, m.
 1. A mountaineer, a barbarian.
 2. A lion.
 3.

Crystal.
 4
. An idol.
शैलालिन्, i. e. *शैलाल + इन्, [] from शिलालिन् (a proper name), m. (properly a follower of the art taught by Śilālin), An actor, a mime.

शैलूष, i. e. शिलूष (a proper name), + अ, m.
 1. An actor, a public dancer,

. The master of the band, or one who beats time.
 3. A rogue, a cheat.
 4. a tree, Aegle marmelos.

शैलेय, i. e. शैल + एय,
 I. adj.
 1. Produced in the mountains.
 2. Mountainous, mountaineer.
 II. m. A bee, Ṛt. 6, 25.
 III. f. यी, Pārvatī.
 IV. n.
 1. Rock-salt.
 2. Benzoin or storax.
 3. A kind of vegetable perfume.
शैल्य, i. e. शिला + य, n. Stoniness, hardness.
+ सार शैल- + सार, adj. firm as a rock,

+ सुता शैल- + सुत, f. ता, Pārvatī, Vikr. d. 128.
 II. सूल,
 1.

Engendered.
 2

. Born. f. ता,
 1. A daughter, Pañc. 181, 5.
 2. A woman lying in; see s. v.
